s01-apples-some.observed_description: A bright kitchen with nobody in it: five shiny red apples lie together in the middle of a bare light wooden kitchen table; no bowl, plate or other food anywhere.
s01-apples-some.note: Usable: some apples on the table, plural and countable; no other apple anywhere in the photo.

s03-books-some.observed_description: A bright living room with nobody in it: a light-grey three-seat sofa with two cushions; a small stack of four hardcover books (red, blue, green, yellow) lies on its middle seat; a tall plant beside the sofa and no table.
s03-books-some.note: Usable: some books on the sofa; the stack is small but reads at 360 px and is central for the 4:5 crop; no table, so no table sentence is true of it.

s05-shoes-some.observed_description: A bright bedroom with nobody in it: a made bed with a white cover on short wooden legs, seen from its foot at a low angle; under the bed on the floor stand three pairs of shoes in a row: white sneakers, brown shoes and red shoes.
s05-shoes-some.note: Usable: some shoes under the bed, clearly under its frame; nothing on the bed.

s02-apples-none.observed_description: The same bright kitchen and light wooden table as s01, now with a completely bare table top; nobody in it.
s02-apples-none.note: Usable: the place, light and camera match s01 and no apple is anywhere, so only the apples tell some from any.

s04-books-none.observed_description: The same living room and grey sofa as s03; the sofa seats are empty except for its two cushions; nobody in it.
s04-books-none.note: Usable: matches s03 with every book removed; no book anywhere in the photo.

s06-shoes-none.observed_description: The same bedroom and made white bed as s05; the floor under the bed is empty and clearly visible; nobody in it.
s06-shoes-none.note: Usable: matches s05 with every shoe removed; no shoe anywhere in the photo.
